sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B-Claude-4.6-OS-Auto-Variable-HERETIC-UNCENSORED-THINKING
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B-Claude-4.6-OS-Auto-Variable-HERETIC-UNCENSORED-THINKING is a Heretic-ablated variant of Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B, published on Hugging Face by DavidAU. It is 2B parameters, runs on a laptop CPU class and apache-2.0 licence. It is distributed across 5 repositories in GGUF, Transformers and GGUF (imatrix) formats, totalling 7.8K downloads.

sources.title: DavidAU/Qwen3.5-2B-Claude-4.6-OS-Auto-Variable-HERETIC-UNCENSORED ...
sources.snippet: Fine tune via Unsloth of Qwen 3.5 2B dense model using Claude-4.6-OS dataset (4 Claude datasets) on local hardware. Every attempt was made to ensure the training was "mild" and did not negatively affect the model's already incrediblely strong benchmarks.
